headline: Bestex (Thailand) Co., Ltd. Discloses Ransomware Attack
body: In a recent announcement, Bestex (Thailand) Co., Ltd., a leading automotive components supplier, revealed it has fallen victim to a ransomware attack. The attackers reportedly stole proprietary internal data, although Bestex (Thailand) Co., Ltd. confirmed its production operations remain unaffected. The company has engaged external cybersecurity experts to investigate the breach and assess the extent of unauthorized access. This incident highlights the growing cybersecurity threats facing the automotive supply chain.
